text:
Anna P.: quick sync — opened a docs PR to update the model catalog limits table and add migration examples for quantized variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

Mike L.: thanks — saw the PR. Is this also adding a new benchmark row for long-seq throughput?

Anna P.: yes — added a small perf row for 8k->32k evaluation (context window), results are from the internal bench run id: bench-2026-03-15-07. numbers are median throughput and p95 latency.

Jamal: pinging re: compatibility notes. we need to call out that the quantized zephyr-aurora variant drops fp16 KV cache compatibility for older runtime (v0.9.x). otherwise rollout will surprise customers.

Anna P.: good catch. i added a compatibility note under "Known limitations" and a migration snippet to use the compatible variant alias (zephyr-aurora-compat).

Olivia: small nit — the SDK snippet uses the old sync client. can we show the streaming async example as well? most customers copy that.

Anna P.: updated — added both examples (sync + streaming). snippet: 

```python
# sync generation
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(model="zephyr-aurora-compat", input="Summarize the release notes")
print(resp.text)

# streaming (async)
from redwood import AsyncRedwoodClient
async with AsyncRedwoodClient() as ac: 
    async for chunk in ac.stream_generate(model="zephyr-aurora-compat", input="Explain the perf delta"):
        print(chunk.text, end='')
```

ryan: FYI the console links in the catalog card pointed to the old dashboard path. i left a comment on the PR with the updated link (/console/models/zephyr-aurora).

Anna P.: thanks, fixed. also added a short migration checklist for Dedicated customers (pin model, test on staging, verify KV cache behavior, roll out canary).

Mike L.: QA asked for a simple prompt set so they can repro the p95 regressions — can we add 3 small prompts in examples?

Anna P.: added three prompts under /examples/migration/prompts.md and linked from the model card. they include long-context, multi-turn, and prompt that stresses tokenization.

qa-bot: automated check — examples link OK, but docs linter warns: line 142 exceeds 120 chars in model-catalog.md.

Anna P.: will fix the wrap and squash the commit.

Jamal: one more: benchmark CSV attachment (bench-2026-03-15.csv) should be referenced in the PR description and stored in /benchmarks/2026/ — can someone ensure it's uploaded?

Olivia: i uploaded it to the repo under /benchmarks/2026/bench-2026-03-15.csv and added the link in PR body.

Anna P.: awesome. last thing — tagging @security for the KMS note. the private deployment paragraph mentions KMS integration; want to make sure phrasing is OK.

ryan: @security would prefer we avoid implying we ship KMS keys; updated language to "customer-managed KMS". also added HSM mention.

Anna P.: perfect. i'll address the linter + squash and merge after approvals. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
